title: My Friend Lena
text:
This is my friend Lena. She is tall and she has long brown hair. She has big green eyes. She is very friendly.

Lena lives in a small house with a red door. The house has a big garden. There are many flowers in the garden. Lena loves her garden very much.

questions.text: What color is the door of Lena's house?
What kind of person is Lena?
Why does Lena probably like her house?
options: It is very big and expensive
She loves her garden and flowers

vocabulary.definition: a place with plants and flowers outside a house
kind and easy to talk to
colorful plants that grow in gardens

paragraph_translations: Це моя подруга Олена. Вона висока, і в неї довге каштанове волосся. У неї великі зелені очі. Вона дуже дружелюбна.
Олена живе в маленькому будинку з червоними дверима. У будинку великий сад. У саду багато квітів. Олена дуже любить свій сад.
